W.note: Very slim collapsed pill with step dots and clean timeline, but ETA and carrier only appear once opened and the collapsed row is a bit sparse on what matters.

X.note: Collapsed row shows status plus ETA window with progress bar, and the open panel adds tracking number with copy, step locations and times, and clear actions in a polished dark UI.

Y.note: Most complete controls (switches, dismiss, labeled region) and a very small collapsed bar, but the opened panel leaves a large empty gap and the ETA is vague.

Z.note: Densest and most compact, with status, ETA, progress, tracking number and next-step buttons in a small footprint, though it rests open and has fewer labelled affordances.
